title: Direct images to the point of bounded constructible complexes are bounded constructible
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] $p,a,q,k_0,k$, a prime $\ell\neq p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $n\geq1$; put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and let $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb\}$. Let $Y$ be a separated finite-type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $k$-scheme with structure morphism $a_Y:Y\to s=\Spec k$. Let $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$ and $D^b_c(s,\Lambda)$ be the bounded constructible categories: finite-torsion constructibility [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] for $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, the derived-complete integral category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] for $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$, the rationalized category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] for $\Lambda=E$ and the common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] for $\Lambda=\Qlb$. Let $Ra_{Y*}$ be the derived direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image] and $Ra_{Y!}$ the compact-support direct image: at finite level the compactification-independent functor [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], which is defined on $D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})$ because every bounded constructible complex on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is of etale origin [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin], and for $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb$ the integral, rational and algebraically closed functors [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Then for every $K\in D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$,

$$
 Ra_{Y*}K\in D^b_c(s,\Lambda)\qquad\text{and}\qquad Ra_{Y!}K\in D^b_c(s,\Lambda).
$$

In particular both lie in the domain of the equivalence $\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,\Lambda)\xrightarrow{\sim}D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A_{E,n}),D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E),D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E),D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)$ of the finite coefficient categories over a point [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point].

source.place: node def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology, order 1510: '$\RGamma(Y,K)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Y*}K)$, $\RGammac(Y,K)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Y!}K)$' (for $\operatorname{Fib}_s$, defined on $D^b_c(s,\Lambda)$, to apply, the direct images must be bounded constructible; the blueprint does not say so). Finite-level ingredients already in the DAG: thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility and sbc-thm-finiteness-finite-type for $Ra_{Y*}$ (on the etale-site categories), prop-finite-compact-support-constructibility for $Ra_{Y!,n}$

proof.text: *Step 1 (the morphism $a_Y$).* By [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] $k$ is an algebraic closure of $\mathbf F_q$, of characteristic $p\neq\ell$, so $\ell$ is invertible in $k$, and every $A_{E,n}$ is a finite ring annihilated by $\ell^{n}$ (as $\varpi_E^{e}\mathcal O_E=\ell\mathcal O_E$ for the ramification index $e$, $\ell^n\in\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$). The point $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ is a finite-type $k$-scheme, and $a_Y:Y\to s$ is the structure morphism of the separated finite-type $k$-scheme $Y$, hence a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. These are the hypotheses of every finiteness result used below, with base field $K_0=k$, source $Y$ and target $s$.

source.place: §6.7, p. 55: $(R,\mathfrak m)$ complete noetherian local with finite residue field of characteristic $\ell$, schemes $\ell$-coprime

proof.text:
*Step 2 ($\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, ordinary direct image).* Put $A=A_{E,n}$ and let $K\in D^b_c(Y,A)$. By [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] (ii) there are a bounded complex $K'$ on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$ with constructible cohomology sheaves, i.e. $K'\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and an isomorphism $K\cong
u_Y^*K'$. By Step 1 and [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility] (applied to $a_Y$ and the finite ring $A$), $Ra_{Y,\mathrm{et}*}K'\in D^b_c(s_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. The morphism $a_Y$ is of finite type, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and $K'$ is bounded below, so [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image] gives $
u_s^*Ra_{Y,\mathrm{et}*}K'\cong Ra_{Y,\mathrm{proet}*}
u_Y^*K'$; the right side is $Ra_{Y*,n}K$ of [def-weil-derived-direct-image] (the total right-derived functor of the pro-etale direct image, both built on [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]). Finally $
u_s^*$ carries $D^b_c(s_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ into $D^b_c(s,A)$ of [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], again by [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] (ii). Hence $Ra_{Y*}K\in D^b_c(s,A)$.

source.place:
Lemma 5.4.3, p. 39 ($
u_X^*f_{\mathrm{et}*}F\simeq f_{\mathrm{proet}*}
u_Y^*F$ for qcqs $f$ and $F\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}})$); Definition 6.5.1 and the remark after it, p. 49 ($D_{cons}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},R/\mathfrak m^n)\simeq D_{cons}(X_{\mathrm{et}},R/\mathfrak m^n)$ via $
u$); Theorem 6.7.1, p. 55, and the proof of Lemma 6.7.2, p. 55 ('constructibility follows from Lemma 5.4.3 and Theorem 6.7.1')

proof.text: *Step 3 ($\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, compact support).* Let $K\in D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})$. By [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] (ii) $K$ is of etale origin, so $K$ lies in the domain on which the compactification-independent functor $Ra_{Y!,n}$ of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] is defined. By Step 1, [prop-finite-compact-support-constructibility] applies with $K_0=k$, $f=a_Y:Y\to s$ and $A=A_{E,n}$: the functor $Ra_{Y!,n}$ restricts to $D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})\to D^b_c(s,A_{E,n})$. Hence $Ra_{Y!}K\in D^b_c(s,A_{E,n})$.

source.place: Definition 6.7.6 and Lemma 6.7.7, p. 56 ($f_!=\bar f_*j_!$ preserves constructibility), at the finite level $R=A_{E,n}$; finite-level theorem: Stacks Project Theorem 63.14.5, Tag 0GL0 (literature/stacks-project/more-etale.tex), through prop-finite-compact-support-constructibility

proof.text: *Step 4 ($\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$, ordinary direct image).* Let $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$. By [def-weil-derived-direct-image], $Ra_{Y*}K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_nRa_{Y*,n}(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})$, the derived limit of the system with the transition maps specified there. By Step 1, [lem-sf-integral-direct-image-constructible] applies with $K_0=k$, $f=a_Y:Y\to s$: this derived limit is derived complete, its reductions are $Ra_{Y*,n}K_n\in D^b_c(s,A_{E,n})$ (Step 2), and their cohomological supports lie in one interval independent of $n$ (with $N=2\dim Y$, $k$ being algebraically closed). That is the definition [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] of $Ra_{Y*}K\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$.

source.place: Lemma 6.7.2 (Pushforward), p. 55, with Lemma 6.5.9 (2), p. 50, and Lemma 6.5.11 (3), p. 51

proof.text: *Step 5 ($\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$, compact support).* Let $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ and let $c=(j,\bar a)$ be the compactification of $a_Y$ chosen in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. There $Ra_{Y!}K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_nRa_{Y!,n}K_n$ is defined as a derived limit of the inverse system $\operatorname{Res}_nRa_{Y!,n}K_n$ with the transition maps built from [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. By Step 1, [lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible] applies with $K_0=k$, $f=a_Y:Y\to s$ and this $c$: every derived limit of this system lies in $D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$. Hence $Ra_{Y!}K\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$.

*Step 6 ($\Lambda=E$).* By [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], $D^b_c(-,E)=D^b_c(-,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi_E]$ has the same objects as $D^b_c(-,\mathcal O_E)$, on $Y$ and on $s$. Let $K_E\in D^b_c(Y,E)$, represented by $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$. On objects the rational direct image of [def-weil-derived-direct-image] is the integral one, $Ra_{Y*}K_E=Ra_{Y*}K$ regarded in $D^b_c(s,E)$, and by [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] $Ra_{Y!}K_E=(Ra_{Y!}K)\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}E$ is the object $Ra_{Y!}K$ regarded in $D^b_c(s,E)$. By Steps 4 and 5 these are objects of $D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$, hence of $D^b_c(s,E)$.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 (2), p. 61 ($D_{cons}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)[\ell^{-1}]\simeq D_{cons}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},E)$) and Remark 6.8.15, p. 62 (the six functors on $D_{cons}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, $\Lambda\in\{\mathcal O_E,E\}$)

proof.text: *Step 7 ($\Lambda=\Qlb$).* By [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] an object of $D^b_c(Y,\Qlb)$ is a pair $(E,K_E)$ with $E\subset\Qlb$ a finite extension of $\Ql$ and $K_E\in D^b_c(Y,E)$, and the objects of $D^b_c(s,\Qlb)$ are the pairs $(E,M)$ with $M\in D^b_c(s,E)$. The direct images are formed at the stage of the representative: $Ra_{Y*}(E,K_E)=(E,Ra_{Y*}K_E)$ by [def-weil-derived-direct-image] (the common-stage category is used for $\Lambda=\Qlb$), and $Ra_{Y!}(E,K_E)=(E,Ra_{Y!}K_E)$ by [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. By Step 6 (for this $E$) both second entries lie in $D^b_c(s,E)$, so both pairs are objects of $D^b_c(s,\Qlb)$. This holds for every representative, so no independence of the stage is needed.

source.place: §6.8, Proposition 6.8.14 (1), pp. 61-62 (colimit over finite subextensions); the common-stage construction is that of def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients

proof.text: *Step 8 (the fibre functor).* By Steps 2 to 7, for each $\Lambda$ the objects $Ra_{Y*}K$ and $Ra_{Y!}K$ lie in $D^b_c(s,\Lambda)$, which is the domain of $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ in [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]; so $\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Y*}K)$ and $\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Y!}K)$ are defined, with values in $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A_{E,n})$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E)$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)$ respectively.

proof_origin.place: §6.7 (Theorem 6.7.1, Lemma 6.7.2, p. 55; Definition 6.7.6, Lemma 6.7.7, p. 56), with Lemma 5.4.3 (p. 39), Lemma 6.5.9 (p. 50), Lemma 6.5.11 (p. 51) and §6.8 (Proposition 6.8.14, Remark 6.8.15, pp. 61-62); finite level through the DAG nodes thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility and prop-finite-compact-support-constructibility (Stacks Project Tag 0GL0)

split_report.summary: The node had no proof. Wrote an 8-step proof following Bhatt-Scholze §6.7-6.8: finite level Ra_{Y*} by etale origin (lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin), the etale finiteness theorem thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility and the comparison prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image (BS Lemma 5.4.3); finite level Ra_{Y!} by prop-finite-compact-support-constructibility; O_E-level Ra_{Y!} by the existing lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible; O_E-level Ra_{Y*} by a new node lem-sf-integral-direct-image-constructible (BS Lemma 6.7.2 with 6.5.9, 6.5.11), the direct-image analogue of the compact-support one, which the DAG lacked; E and Qlbar levels are elementary from the definitions (same objects, stagewise operations). sbc-thm-finiteness-finite-type, named in the source field, is not used: thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility and prop-finite-compact-support-constructibility cover its two clauses. Statement and stmt_deps unchanged.
